authority.selection: when the current path exists and no explicit jobs-path override is set, WPF reads SQLite; otherwise it reads the explicitly selected SQLite or JSON path, or falls back to legacy JSON
authority.singleWriter: the loopback companion owns all writes
authority.migration: pause and drain before import; preserve every logical job, queue order, pause state, and receipt; retain the source JSON and a verified rollback export

enhancement_jobs.operation: a non-empty string when present; absence is the legacy upscale representation
enhancement_jobs.operationSpecificProjection: i2i retains preset and video retains video so WPF can classify the operation and gate mutations without reading payload_json
enhancement_jobs.catalogConsumer: the managed-media catalog may ignore fields beyond id and status for failed, canceled, deleted, or unknown rows; this does not permit the writer to omit the common Jobs projection

jobsWorkspaceSurface.purpose: render the complete Jobs inventory from compact per-job projections without transporting or eagerly materializing every full job payload

requiredColumns.status: queued, running, succeeded, failed, canceled, or deleted
requiredColumns.reader_payload_json: UTF-8 JSON object containing the compact WPF-visible job projection

enhancement_jobs.rowBinding: reader_payload_json id and status must exactly match the relational row
enhancement_jobs.legacyOperationDefault: absence of operation means upscale; a present known operation must parse as that same operation

jobDetailSurface.selection: payload_json is queried only for the exact selected id after an explicit Details or Copy action

requiredColumns.id: must exactly match the selected Jobs row
requiredColumns.status: must still exactly match the selected Jobs row
requiredColumns.payload_json: UTF-8 JSON object containing the complete durable job payload

jobDetailSurface.identityBinding: payload_json id, status, operation, source identity, preset id, and adapter id must exactly match the displayed compact projection
jobDetailSurface.retention: a loaded detail string may be released when Details closes and is refreshed before Copy

jobsWorkspaceSurface.snapshot: one deferred transaction on a read-only query_only connection
jobsWorkspaceSurface.payloadHandling: validate and project reader_payload_json one row at a time; do not read all payload_json values or construct one aggregate all-jobs response
jobsWorkspaceSurface.failure: malformed, unsupported, or over-limit state fails closed and preserves the last validated Jobs view
jobsWorkspaceSurface.mutations: enqueue, retry, cancel, reorder, dismiss, output deletion, pause, resume, wake, claim, and recovery remain authenticated companion API operations

catalogRevision.incrementsFor: changes to the WPF-visible managed-media projection, including add, remove, source identity, status, and managed-output identity
catalogRevision.readerUse: probe before rebuilding the direct managed-media projection

wpfRules.sqliteRuntimeSidecars: SQLite may create or update only its standard -wal and -shm coordination sidecars; those files are not a second logical writer or product-data authority
wpfRules.unsupportedOrMalformed: fail the direct Enhancement projection closed without rewriting either store
wpfRules.explicitOverride: an explicit jobs-path override is authoritative and is never silently replaced by its SQLite sibling
